concerns.text: Task T013 states it will implement data writing logic to save generated datasets, but does *not* explicitly mention generating or saving separate held-out test instances, violating FR-004 and failing to provide the baseline measurements for SC-001/SC-003 as outlined in the spec.

Task T026 only implements the calculation of accuracy drop for forgetting rates; it lacks the implementation of the Mixed-Design ANOVA (as mandated by Constitution Principle VII and FR-006), creating a gap in the end-to-end verification of SC-001.

The task description for creating contract tests is vague ('define JSON schema validators'). It lacks specifics on implementation or tools, potentially leading to inconsistent or non-functional tests.

Tasks T011, T012, T013, T014, T015, T018, T019, T020, T021, T022 are all marked as 'declared artifact(s) missing/empty/invalid', indicating a systemic failure to produce the required deliverables, blocking progress.
Task T001a only creates subdirectories under `src/` without establishing the root `src/` directory itself, violating the planned project structure outlined in the plan.md.
FR-006 requires a selection pressure to discard non-performing rule-sets, but task T021 only mentions bidirectional exchange. The selection pressure logic is missing.
